description: IRC Section 179 overall limits and phase-out thresholds by tax year

2026.notes: Projected inflation adjustment (subject to IRS confirmation)

rules: Section 179 deduction is limited to taxable income from active trade/business
Deduction phases out dollar-for-dollar when total property placed in service exceeds threshold
Once total placed in service exceeds (threshold + maxDeduction), no §179 is available
Used property acquired from unrelated party qualifies (post-TCJA)
Real property improvements (qualified improvement property) may qualify under certain conditions

recapture.description: If business use drops to 50% or less in any year during recovery period, §179 deduction must be recaptured
recapture.calculation: Recapture = (§179 deduction - what would have been allowed via MACRS) + interest
recapture.note: System currently assumes 100% business use throughout; recapture events require manual review
